name: Ōshima (Tokyo, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōshima town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a ring with a downward triangle and a small disc, like a stylised flower.
history: Municipal flag of Ōshima, a town in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1957.

features.role: Ōshima town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a ring with a downward triangle and a small disc, like a stylised flower
